title: Jade Cat Ascension
subtitle: Cat Life Restart · Cultivation Simulator
description: A jade pendant sends a house cat into a cultivation world. Draw talents, experience random events, and let cultivation, body, belly, luck, morality and lifespan decide what immortal you become.

catalog.eyebrow: A third glimmer has woken up
catalog.cardDescription: Cat life restart: draw talents, random cultivation events, attributes decide the ending. You can't die - you just become an unexpected immortal.
catalog.actionSummary: Draw talents · Random events · Attribute endings

states.label: Cultivation
states.description: Mastery of spirit energy and spells

states.label: Belly
states.description: All the spirit fruit and pills eaten

milestones.title: Spirit energy enters the body
milestones.text: Your meridians start absorbing spirit energy on their own. You cultivate even while sleeping.

milestones.title: Too fat to fly
milestones.text: You tried the wind-riding technique. The wind said you're too heavy.

milestones.title: Dark energy grows
milestones.text: A dark vein surfaces on your jade pendant. Only you can see it.

milestones.title: Favored by heaven
milestones.text: You can't take a step without stepping on a spirit herb. The elders suspect you've opened a heaven eye.

events.title: The pendant wakes up
events.event: In an afternoon room, an old jade pendant suddenly glows. You reach out one paw and the whole world flips.

events.title: The gate takes cats
events.event: You land in front of the Jade Sect gate above a sea of clouds. The elder is choosing new disciples.

events.title: Morning drill
events.event: Senior brothers line up to practice. You line up at the end and copy their movements.

events.title: Library encounter
events.event: You sneak into the archive and find an unnamed manual in the far corner. The cover has a cat on it.

events.title: Kitchen duty
events.event: It's your turn to help cook. The crane says the spirit rice should be softer than yesterday.

events.title: Cloud nap
events.event: You slept on the cloud terrace all afternoon. When you woke, someone had tucked a thin spirit-mist blanket over you.

events.title: Chasing a butterfly
events.event: A glowing butterfly flies past. You chased it across three mountain peaks.

events.title: Accidental pill
events.event: You accidentally ate an unfinished pill. Your stomach rumbled for a whole hour.

events.title: Pill festival
events.event: The sect holds an elixir fair. You crouch in the corner and sniff them one by one.

events.title: Cultivating in the rain
events.event: It rains. Other cats hide; you stand in it and cultivate. There's spirit energy in the rain.

events.title: Crane's gift
events.event: A crane drops a spirit fish in front of you. It looks deliberate.

events.title: Meditation
events.event: You sit in the spirit array. After an hour you open your eyes and find thin ice on your whiskers.

events.title: Cave cleaning
events.event: It's your turn to clean the cave. You swept all the dust to your senior brother's door.

events.title: Night watch
events.event: It's your turn to keep watch. The moonlight is bright and you see three night spirit beasts you've never seen before.

events.title: Mouse swordsman
events.event: A rogue mouse-swordsman blocks the way. His tail is tied in a nervous knot.

events.title: Secret realm opens
events.event: A spinning gate of light appears in the mountain wall.

events.title: The fruit tempts
events.event: The only ten-thousand-year spirit fruit is ripe, and the orchard crane is away.

choices.text: Eat it all with fish paste

events.title: A test of heart
events.event: Your senior collapsed by the stone steps, a glowing treasure box beside them.

events.title: Cliff-side ginseng
events.event: You spot a nine-leaf spirit ginseng on the cliff edge. The wind is strong.

events.title: Dream transmission
events.event: You meet a white-haired immortal in a dream. He hands you a key.

events.title: Merchant cat
events.event: A merchant cat appears at the gate, selling strange things.

events.title: The dragon's invitation
events.event: A silver dragon circles above the castle and looks down at you. It says it wants to invite you to dinner.

events.title: Early tribulation
events.event: Heavenly thunder falls, three hundred years ahead of schedule.

events.title: Ancient cat ruins
events.event: You find a cat statue in an abandoned immortal palace. Its eyes are moving.

events.title: Time fruit
events.event: You ate a time fruit. You stood in place for a hundred years, but it felt like one second.

events.title: The fox asks
events.event: A nine-tailed spirit fox asks you to teach it cat hunting techniques. You taught it 'pretend not to care'.

events.title: The immortal cat's last words
events.event: Deep in a cave you find a stone tablet. The last cat who ascended left one sentence: 'Remember to eat enough.'

events.title: Heaven's gift
events.event: A golden light falls from the sky and lands on you. You burp.

events.title: The ten-thousand-cat assembly
events.event: Every cat who ever ascended is watching you from the cloud sea. One of them winks.

events.title: The samsara pond
events.event: You see your past life at the reincarnation pond: a lazy house cat lying in the best patch of sunlight.

endings.title: Immortal King of Ten Thousand Cats
endings.description: Your cultivation runs through heaven and earth, and your heart holds against every temptation. You ascend as king. First decree: one extra midnight meal every day.

endings.title: Free and Wicked Cat Immortal
endings.description: You cut through shortcuts and became a rogue immortal. The sect posted a notice: valuable boxes should be fitted with cat locks.

endings.title: The Chubby Guardian Cat
endings.description: Your belly took the last ray of lightning. You became the most popular guardian cat: daily duty is guarding the spirit orchard and tasting the harvest.

endings.title: Child of Fortune
endings.description: You didn't try, but every step landed exactly right. Fate said: this cat is under my protection.

endings.title: Carefree Cat Immortal
endings.description: You lived steadily and became an ordinary, comfortable immortal. Cloud seas, sunshine and dried fish are already enough.
